activity_summary: You went to evening prayer and left the receipt at the house. Master Thwaite kept the hour to the day. Mistress Ansell sat it without counting the twenty shillings again. You leave in the morning.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came without the receipt, and said he leaves in the morning.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Kept the hour on the day, and did not preach him to the door.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Sat it, and declined to count the quarter a second time in the pew.

entities.name: 20s the quarter
entities.context: Mentioned in The day, not the receipt

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have not brought the receipt into the pew.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: This hour is the day. Let it be the day, and not a saddle-bag.
